project: Hematological and Glycemic Decomposition of Depression
purpose: External validation of frozen physiology and phenotype frameworks; no re-fitting or harmonization is implied by downloading.

KNHANES.design: Repeated cross-sectional survey; not within-person follow-up
KNHANES.access: Official raw-data download interface; accept provider terms/pledge as required. Do not assume unauthenticated direct links.
KNHANES.primary_goal: Potential PHQ-9 replication; verify seven exact biomarkers and same-person survey modules first.
KNHANES.restriction: Respect official KDCA data terms; check variable availability and survey design per year.

MIDUS.design: Longitudinal cohort with linked biomarker and other survey/cognitive projects; linkage and overlapping sample must be checked.
MIDUS.access: Public-use; create/log into an ICPSR account and accept each download's terms; a separate MIDUS Portal registration may be required.
MIDUS.primary_goal: Longitudinal biomarker/cognition and depression-instrument transfer; verify full seven-marker coverage before exact X->Z transfer.
MIDUS.restriction: MIDUS data must NOT be uploaded to public AI/LLM services or redistributed. Use for non-commercial research; suppress reporting cells with n < 10.
